name: EXM_TRAVEL_ITINERARIES
description: This table contains summary information about imported travel itineraries from travel partners.

columns.name: TRAVEL_ITINERARY_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier of a travel itinerary.

columns.name: TRAVEL_PARTNER_TRIP_NUMBER
columns.description: Trip in the travel partner's system with which travel itinerary is associated with.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ITINERARY_RECORD_LOCATOR
columns.description: Travel itinerary in the travel partner's system, which is passenger name record for itineraries booked from global distribution system or rail confirmation number for rail itineraries.

columns.name: TRIP_ID
columns.description: Business trip for which itinerary belongs to.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: TRAVEL_INTEGRATION_ID
columns.description: Travel Partner Integration from which itinerary is imported.

columns.name: BOOKING_SITE_ID
columns.description: Booking site from which itinerary was booked.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of imported travel itinerary, such as Active for itineraries that do not contain AIR or RAIL reservations, Ticketed for itineraries that contain AIR or RAIL itineraries, and Cancelled for itineraries that are cancelled.

columns.name: INITIAL_DESTINATION
columns.description: Initial destination city name for itinerary, which is set to the first departure location for reservation items belonging to this itinerary.  This column is used to populat the trip location.  For multiple destination trips, first and last destination locations are displayed.

columns.name: FINAL_DESTINATION
columns.description: Final destination city name for itinerary, which is set to last destination location for reservation items belonging to this itinerary.  This column is used to populate the trip location.  For multiple destination trips, first and last destination locations are displayed.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of this itinerary will be set to the earliest date among the reservation items belonging to this itinerary in local timezone.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date of this itinerary will be set to the latest date among the reservation items belonging to this itinerary in local timezone.

columns.name: FIRST_NAME
columns.description: First name of the traveler in this reservation.

columns.name: LAST_NAME
columns.description: Last name of the traveler in this reservation.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Traveler as a person in Oracle Fusion Human Resources.

columns.name: EMPLOYEE_NUMBER
columns.description: Employee number of traveler for reservation.

columns.name: BOOKING_DATE_TIME
columns.description: Date and time in UTC when this Itinerary was created or modified in the global distribution system or travel partner system.

columns.name: AIR_UPDATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether air reservation in itinerary has changed from initial import.

columns.name: HOTEL_UPDATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether hotel reservation in itinerary has changed from initial import.

columns.name: RAIL_UPDATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether rail reservation in itinerary has changed from initial import.

columns.name: VEHICLE_UPDATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether vehicle rental reservation in itinerary has changed from initial import.
